query: Oracle remaining performance obligations RPO latest quarter
normalized: obligations oracle performance quarter remaining rpo

output.content: Oracle’s latest reported remaining performance obligations (RPO) were **$638 billion** at the end of **fiscal Q4 2026** (reported June 10, 2026), representing **363% year-over-year growth** and an **$85 billion sequential increase** from $553 billion at the end of Q3. [[1]]

sources.title: Oracle - Oracle Announces Record Q4 and FY 2026 Results Driven by Cloud Infrastructure & Cloud Applications
